The wrap comes from the nav’s fixed `360px` width combined with four padded links whose minimum widths exceed that box. I’m removing that artificial constraint and keeping the desktop nav on one line.

openclawStreamFallback.replacementText: The wrap comes from the nav’s fixed `360px` width combined with four padded links whose minimum widths exceed that box. I’m removing that artificial constraint and keeping the desktop nav on one line.

arguments.command:
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: site/styles.css
@@
-.nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 360px; }
+.nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
*** End Patch
PATCH
arguments.title: Fix nav wrapping

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: site/styles.css
@@

*** End Patch
PATCH
input.title: Fix nav wrapping
